correctness.rationale: For every coordinate, stationarity at an interior cosine forces zero local coefficient and an exactly flat coordinate, excluding strict minima. At each spin vertex the Hessian is diagonal. Under 0<epsilon<h1<h2<h3<2-epsilon, each triangle with one minus has positive curvature between the stated constants, while every alternative spin pattern has a negative Hessian diagonal. Hence exactly 3^m strict minima. Repairing a wrongly located minus lowers field energy by at least 2(h2-h1) and changes at most two bridges by total 4epsilon; thus unique ground placement and uniform gap. Independent uniform angles give the exact gradient second moment from cosine orthogonality. All statements are analytic; finite enumeration is corroborative.

originality.rationale: Existing source Q1 evidence is an instance-specific finite count; classical Ising spin-glass literature already knows generic exponential metastability. The new claim is an exact parametric connected degree-three VQE family with simultaneously classified strict minima, nondegenerate uniform Hessian, unique ground state and gap, and explicit unsuppressed gradient variance. Source, alias and implication comparisons found no dominating formulation.
residual_risks: Exponential numbers of spin-glass metastable states are classical and not original by themselves; a differently indexed deterministic pinned-triangle gadget could already imply the exact count.
The theorem is restricted to the diagonal product-rotation benchmark with weak bridge couplings, not the exact unit-magnitude disorder samples of the source.
Neither the exact count nor the nonvanishing average gradient provides an optimizer runtime lower bound.

value.rationale: The anchor carefully separates optimizer basin geometry from exact ansatz reachability and barren-gradient diagnostics, but can enumerate only finite saved instances. The theorem supplies an all-size, connected, bounded-degree, open-parameter benchmark where these three features are simultaneously quantified: exactly 3^m well-curved local minima, one accessible ground state and 3^m-1 suboptimal traps with a constant energy gap, while gradient variance per parameter stays above 1/2. This is a concrete robust structural separation rather than an arbitrary single parameter substitution or a re-tabulation of the paper numbers.
